comment: What the 27 October runs measured (the stream-json of the medium and failure-modes kits' out/ folders, read on 3 November 2026 by counting distinct assistant message ids as requests, summing result.total_cost_usd, and differencing the unifiedWindows utilization of the rate_limit_events inside each session). The account of those runs was of an unknown tier and is not the account of this block.

window_size.caveat: utilization has two decimals and other use of the account inside those windows would make these sizes too small; the tier of that account is not known, so the size of a Pro window is not read from them: plan/pro.mjs takes a fifth as an assumption until the smoke sessions measure it
